item.name: 05 - Trainings

request.description: Public list of published trainings with filters (specialization_id, skill_id, training_type, work_mode, paid, employment_possible, company_id, city, keyword). Training keyword search lives in the dedicated Search API: GET /api/v1/search/trainings?q=... Training specializations come exclusively from training_specializations (inherited from the company's company_specializations); there is no training field filter, sort (newest/oldest/title/name/deadline/relevance) and pagination. Works without a token; a student token adds per-item is_saved. AUTHENTICATED STUDENTS: results are automatically restricted to published trainings owned by companies whose registered specialization (company_specializations) matches the student's own students.specialization_id. The student does not send any parameter for this and query parameters cannot override it; a student without a specialization receives an empty list (total=0). All other filters, sorting and pagination still apply on top of this restriction.
